points_add: NovoTech value line: positioners 33 – 8,818 lb with chucks, hollow bores and motorized tilt; TRS turning rolls 2,205 – 11,023 lb
Pipe stands and supports to 19,800 lb, the WT-36X24 fixture table and MDT downdraft tables 1,350 – 3,700 CFM

faq_add.a: A positioner holds the part on a turntable or in a chuck and turns it about its own axis, tilted to bring the joint to the flat position: the machine for flanges, short pipe spools, hubs and parts up to about the size of the table. Turning rolls carry a long round part — pipe, a tank shell, a pressure vessel — on wheels and turn it under the torch: the machine for long and heavy work. Long pipe in a positioner chuck needs an outboard support stand at the far end.

faq_add.q: How do I size a positioner for my part?
faq_add.a: By the weight and where its centre of gravity sits. The rating is for the centre of gravity close to the table centre and face: the further it is from the axis (an off-centre bracket) or from the table (a tall part), the more torque the drive and the tilt need. The heavy WP positioners are rated with the centre of gravity up to 12″ from the table centre and 12″ above it. For off-centre or tall parts choose the next size up, and send us a sketch with the weight.
